title: Provider Error-State Certification

observations.user_message: Authentication failed. Sign in again to continue.
Access was revoked. Reconnect the account.
Permission denied for this scope. Review the connected app permissions.
Rate limited. Try again in 30 seconds.
This region is not supported by the provider.
The current plan does not include this feature.

error_state_rules.invalid_credentials: 401-class; not retryable; requires re-authentication; user message must not echo credential material
error_state_rules.expired: 401-class; not retryable; requires a refresh flow before any further request
error_state_rules.revoked: 401-class; not retryable; permanent until the account is reconnected
error_state_rules.scope_denied: 403-class; not retryable; requires a consent or permission change
error_state_rules.rate_limited: 429-class; retryable only after a positive retry_after value; retry_after is mandatory
error_state_rules.outage: 5xx-class; retryable with backoff; retry_after may stay unknown and null
error_state_rules.unsupported_region: permanent for the region; not retryable
error_state_rules.unsupported_plan: permanent for the plan; not retryable
